description: This file defines the IFrontPanel interface in the WPEFramework::Exchange namespace, which provides methods for controlling and querying a front panel's lights, LEDs, brightness, and blink patterns. It includes method declarations for configuring the front panel, getting brightness, managing lights and LEDs, and setting LED colors and blink patterns.

classes.name: IFrontPanel
classes.description: Interface for controlling front panel features such as lights, LEDs, brightness, and blink patterns.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the front panel with the provided service.

methods.name: GetBrightness
methods.description: Retrieves the brightness level for a given index.

methods.name: GetFrontPanelLights
methods.description: Retrieves the list of supported front panel lights and related info.

methods.name: SetBlink
methods.description: Sets a blink pattern for a specified LED using a JSON string.

methods.name: SetBrightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness level for a specified LED.

methods.name: SetLED
methods.description: Sets the color and brightness of a specified LED.

calls: Core::hresult SetLED(const string&, uint32_t, const string&, uint32_t, uint32_t, uint32_t, FrontPanelSuccess&)
